cta_caption: Comment STORIES aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: REPLY YA [MENTION]
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: Story pe **reply** (ya keyword) ya story mein **mention** → **auto DM**.

slides.headline: "REPLY [LINK]"
slides.label: STORY REPLIES
lines: Story pe "reply **LINK**" likho: reply karne wale ko **seconds** mein link.

slides.headline: [SABKO] SAME MESSAGE
slides.label: OR
lines: Ya har story reply ko **same message** bhejo.

slides.headline: MENTION = [THANKS]
slides.label: MENTIONS
lines: Mention karne walon ko **auto thank-you** ya **discount code**.

slides.headline: [GOODWILL] + MENTIONS
slides.label: WHY
lines: Goodwill banta hai aur **aur mentions** aate hain.

slides.headline: [FREE] HAI?
slides.label: FAQ
lines: Haan, story replies aur mentions **har plan** pe, **Free** bhi.
